title: Tunisian Quesadilla
description: A delicious and healthy twist on the classic Mexican dish. This Tunisian quesadilla is filled with the exotic flavors of Tunisia, wrapped in a crispy tortilla.

ingredients.name: tortillas
ingredients.notes: use whole wheat or whole grain tortillas for a healthier option

instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together the tunisian spices and a pinch of salt.
Brush both sides of the tortillas with a little bit of oil.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle a quarter of the tunisian spice mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Add a quarter of the hummus, carrots, parsley, and feta cheese (if using) on top of the spice mixture.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the filling is heated through.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling ingredients.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
